question: Who among the following is the author of the book 'Sea of Poppies'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amitav Ghosh**__.

__
 
• **Amitav Ghosh**** **is the author of the book '**Sea of Poppies**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amitav Ghosh** was born on **July 11, 1956, in Kolkata**. He received a** B.A. degree in 1976 **and an** M.A. in 1978 **from the **University of Delhi.**
 
• Amitav Ghosh is an Indian writer and the winner of the **54th Jnanpith award,** best known for his work in English fiction.
 
• He won the Jnanpith award for his **contribution to the enrichment of Indian literature in English in 2019.**
 
• His first novel was **The Circle of Reason** published in the year **1986**.
 
• **Ghosh's works include:**__
 __
 
• **The Circle of Reason **(his 1986 debut novel), **The Shadow Lines **(1988), **The Glass Palace** (2000), **The Hungry Tide **(2004), and** Sea of Poppies** (2008), the first volume of The Ibis trilogy, set in the 1830s just before the Opium War and encapsulating the East's colonial history.
